messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Use exactly 7 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "=====". Start your response with this exact line: "Welcome to the school.". None of these may appear in the response: ['lunch'].

Write a funny letter to 6th graders at your school. The letter should be about something important to you. Do not use any divider lines between paragraphs. Begin with the line "Welcome to our school." and don’t put any other content before it. Include all of these keywords or phrases at least once: ['lunch']. Use at most 6 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.)
